from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# Create a contingency table for the 'discipline' and 'compensation' variables
contingency_table = df.groupby(['discipline', 'compensation.o', 'compensation.r']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Perform chi-squared test
chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)
